claims: Dunkin' is offering 1,000,001 free coffees to Dunkin' Rewards members on April 1, 2026.
The free coffees are redeemed using the code STILLNOTAJOKE in the Dunkin' app.
The deal applies to any size hot or iced coffee while supplies last.
The free Dunkin' coffee offer is on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The offer is for free hot or iced coffee of any size.
The offer requires being a Dunkin' Rewards member.
Dunkin' Rewards membership is free to join.
Dunkin' Rewards members earn 100 points per $1 spent on qualifying purchases.
Dunkin' Rewards members can redeem 600 points for free coffee or tea.
Dunkin' Rewards provides a free beverage on the member's birthday
